decisions.reason: After four years, the learning value of this distant maritime niche is likely largely exhausted, and a large expanding lighting firm would redeploy resources from a specialized submarine line to stronger core LED opportunities.

A medical examination light is adjacent but still outside the firm's main professional lighting channels, and by now management would likely judge that uncertainty has resolved enough to exit if traction has not become clearly attractive.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires fit the firm's industrial engineering strengths, certification capabilities and professional customer base, so the option remains strategically attractive enough to retain.
A pendant office luminaire is close to the core range and inexpensive to support within the existing portfolio, so keeping it preserves a useful mainstream office-lighting option.
The premium pendant line is close to the established offer and, as a multi-model range, likely supports both margin and market coverage, making continued retention the more likely choice.
